title: 最长回文子串长度
description: 求字符串 $s$ 中最长的**回文子串**长度（子串必须连续）。
hint: 枚举每个中心向两边扩展，注意奇偶两种长度的回文。

solutions.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
s = data[0]
nn = len(s)
best = 0
for i2 in range(nn):
    l2 = r2 = i2
    while l2 >= 0 and r2 < nn and s[l2] == s[r2]:
        best = max(best, r2 - l2 + 1); l2 -= 1; r2 += 1
    l2, r2 = i2, i2 + 1
    while l2 >= 0 and r2 < nn and s[l2] == s[r2]:
        best = max(best, r2 - l2 + 1); l2 -= 1; r2 += 1
print(best)
